      - name: Install Node.js

      - name: Install Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v31
      - name: Install dependencies without lifecycle scripts

      - name: Bound apt network waits

        timeout-minutes: 1

        run: |
          sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake pkg-config zstd ripgrep
      - name: Prepare Lean, wasm-tools and Wasmtime
        timeout-minutes: 30
        run: |
          bash scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh --lean-only

          (
            set -euo pipefail
            test "$(uname -sm)" = 'Linux x86_64'

            test ! -e build/wasmtime-c-api && test ! -L build/wasmtime-c-api

            curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 300 \

            echo '2097a47351918a446b26c7e65f487278f63bc947591b71897db547cd90c05082'"  $WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/wasmtime.tar.xz" | sha256sum --check --status
            mkdir "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/unpacked"

            test -s "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/unpacked/include/wasm.h"
            test -s "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/unpacked/lib/libwasmtime.so"
            test -s "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/unpacked/lib/libwasmtime.a"

          )

        run: |

          bash scripts/run-optional-parameter-wit-ci.sh
      - name: Preserve optional-parameter WIT acceptance

            --performance "$performance" --test-result "$test_result" \
            --package-installation "$executed" --real-lean-execution "$executed" \
            --command "$command"
      - name: Upload final WIT and WASI observations
        if: always()

        with:
          name: consumer-results-wasi-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/consumer-ci/results/*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          overwrite: true
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Enforce the combined WIT and WASI result
        if: always() && (needs.wasi-consumer.result != 'success' || needs.wasi-qualifications.result != 'success')
        run: exit 1
